==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. Cloaked we observed the Bat Knights traveling in the Storyverse. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (We includes Johnson, Second Brain, and I.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet.) (Second Brain is a floating brain made of Lucid Light.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars.) (Bat Knights are humanoid vampire bats dressed in purple knight's armor with a bat insignia on the chest. After consuming the blood of a Lucid Light cow, they possess the power to wield Lucid Light.)
We created three keys made of Lucid Light and a lock for the Elven Village.
Hopefully this will be enough to ensure that the Bat Knights never find our home reality.
